name: RifleReadyIdle
description: Two second combat-ready idle for the CC0 reference rig: a waist-up weight shift, a slow breath in the neck, and a head scan. The AK47 is socketed to the rig root, so its track is generated by 'follow' from the Spine2 rotation instead of hand-written quaternions.

checks.comment: the reference body is a self-intersecting game asset (thousands of baseline pairs), so new-pair collisions cannot be judged here; the grip drift and frame validity still are

follow.comment: keep the rifle rigid with the chest so both hands stay on it

tracks.comment: waist twist, +2 deg right then -2 deg left; the rifle follows this
breath: the chest cannot move without pulling the hands off the rifle
scan right, hold, scan left, recentre
